subject: economics
title: The Role of the State in the Macroeconomy

questions.question: Explain two reasons why a government might choose to use progressive taxation. (6 marks)
Assess the validity of the Laffer curve as a basis for government tax policy. (10 marks)
Evaluate the view that controlling the activities of transnational corporations is essential for developing countries to achieve sustainable economic growth. (20 marks)
Outline two differences between a fiscal deficit and the national debt. (4 marks)
Explain how an increase in government borrowing to finance public expenditure may lead to crowding out. (4 marks)

A country's income tax charges nothing on the first $5,000 of income, 10% on income between $5,000 and $25,000, and 30% on income above $25,000. Calculate the average rate of income tax paid by a person earning $40,000. (2 marks)

A country's income tax charges nothing on the first $5,000 of income, 10% on income between $5,000 and $25,000, and 30% on income above $25,000. Calculate the average rate of income tax paid at incomes of $20,000 and $80,000, and use your answers to state whether the tax is progressive. (4 marks)
Analyse how an increase in the rate of an indirect tax may affect the price level and real output in an economy. (6 marks)
Evaluate the likely economic effects of a significant cut in the rates of direct taxation. (20 marks)
Examine the significance of a large national debt for an economy. (8 marks)
Discuss the effectiveness of the demand-side policies used in response to the global financial crisis of 2008. (14 marks)
Evaluate the policies a government might use to reduce a large fiscal deficit. (20 marks)
Evaluate the measures governments can use to control the activities of transnational corporations (TNCs). (20 marks)
